arXiv:2605.10873v1 [cs.CV] 2026 年 5 月 11 日arXiv:2605.10873v1 [cs.CV] 11 May 2026

CAD基准CadBench：AI 辅助 CAD 程序生成的多模式基准: A Multimodal Benchmark for AI-Assisted CAD Program Generation

Anna C. Doris  Jacob Thomas Sony  Ghadi Nehme  Era Syla  Amin Heyrani Nobari
Faez Ahmed
Massachusetts Institute of Technology
摘要Abstract

从图像或 3D 观察中恢复可编辑的 CAD 程序是人工智能辅助设计的核心，但进展很难衡量，因为现有的评估在数据集、模式和指标中分散。我们推出 CADBench，这是多模式 CAD 程序生成的统一基准。 CADBench 包含来自 DeepCAD、Fusion 360、ABC、MCB 和 Objaverse 的六个基准系列的 18,000 个评估样本；五种输入模式，包括干净网格、噪声网格、单视图渲染、真实感渲染和多视图渲染；以及涵盖几何保真度、可执行性和程序紧凑性的六个指标。基于 STEP 的族按 B-rep 面孔计数进行分层，并且对所有族进行多样性抽样，以支持跨复杂性和对象变化的受控分析。我们对 11 个 CAD 专用和通用视觉语言系统进行了基准测试，生成了超过 140 万个 CAD 程序。在理想化输入下，专门的网格到 CAD 模型的性能大大优于代码生成 VLM，而后者距离可靠的 CAD 程序重建还很远。 CADBench 进一步揭示了三种反复出现的故障模式：重建质量随几何复杂性而降低、CAD 专用模型在模态转换下可能会变得脆弱，以及模型排名随指标变化。总之，这些结果使 CADBench 成为衡量可编辑 3D 重建和多模式 CAD 理解进展的诊断测试平台。该基准可在以下位置公开获取：Recovering editable CAD programs from images or 3D observations is central to AI-assisted design, but progress is difficult to measure because existing evaluations are fragmented across datasets, modalities, and metrics. We introduce CADBench, a unified benchmark for multimodal CAD program generation. CADBench contains 18,000 evaluation samples spanning six benchmark families derived from DeepCAD, Fusion 360, ABC, MCB, and Objaverse; five input modalities including clean meshes, noisy meshes, single-view renders, photorealistic renders, and multi-view renders; and six metrics covering geometric fidelity, executability, and program compactness. STEP-based families are stratified by B-rep face count and all families are diversity-sampled to support controlled analysis across complexity and object variation. We benchmark eleven CAD-specialized and general-purpose vision-language systems, generating more than 1.4 million CAD programs. Under idealized inputs, specialized mesh-to-CAD models substantially outperform code-generating VLMs, which remain far from reliable CAD program reconstruction. CADBench further reveals three recurring failure modes: reconstruction quality degrades with geometric complexity, CAD-specialized models can be brittle under modality shift, and model rankings change across metrics. Together, these results position CADBench as a diagnostic testbed for measuring progress in editable 3D reconstruction and multimodal CAD understanding. The benchmark is publicly available athttps://huggingface.co/datasets/DeCoDELab/CADBench.

1 简介Introduction

计算机辅助设计 (CAD) 模型在结构化参数化程序中对实体几何进行编码，从而能够在工程工作流程中对设计形式进行精确、可编辑的控制。然而，创建此类模型仍然耗时且需要大量专业知识：先前的研究估计，即使是经验丰富的工程师也可能需要几周的时间才能为航空航天零件等现实世界的组件构建详细的 CAD 模型Computer-aided design (CAD) models encode solid geometry in structured, parametric programs, enabling precise, editable control over design form in engineering workflows. However, creating such models remains time-consuming and expertise-intensive: prior studies estimate that even experienced engineers may require on the order of weeks to construct detailed CAD models for real-world components such as aerospace parts[1]。这一成本激发了人们对直接根据用户输入生成可编辑 CAD 程序的 AI 系统的浓厚兴趣. This cost has motivated significant interest in AI systems that generate editable CAD programs directly from user inputs[2]。与仅重建最终 3D 几何体（例如网格、体素或点云）的方法不同，CAD 程序生成旨在生成可修改、重新参数化并集成到设计和制造流程中的输出。最近的工作探索了从不同输入（包括文本描述）生成 CAD. Unlike approaches that reconstruct only final 3D geometry, such as meshes, voxels, or point clouds, CAD program generation aims to produce outputs that can be modified, re-parameterized, and integrated into design and manufacturing pipelines. Recent work has explored CAD generation from diverse inputs, including text descriptions[3, 4, 5], 2D 图像或绘图, 2D images or drawings[6, 7, 8, 9]，以及 3D 观察，例如网格或点云, and 3D observations such as meshes or point clouds[10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15]。这些方法涵盖通用多模式模型. These approaches span general-purpose multimodal models[16, 17], 微调语言模型, fine-tuned language models[3, 7]和 CAD 特定架构, and CAD-specific architectures[12, 18].

尽管人工智能驱动的 CAD 生成取得了快速进展，但评估却没有跟上步伐。现有的 CAD 生成方法通常在狭窄的数据集或测试分割上进行评估，例如 DeepCADDespite rapid progress in AI-driven CAD generation, evaluation has not kept pace. Existing CAD generation methods are typically assessed on narrow datasets or test splits, such as DeepCAD[19], Fusion 360 画廊, Fusion 360 Gallery[20]，和微型断路器, and MCB[21]。方法通常根据不同的输入模式和指标进行评估，这使得方法之间的直接比较变得困难。当前的基准测试也很少控制复杂性和多样性，常常高估 CAD 系统在相对简单或统一示例上的性能。他们经常依赖干净的、源自 CAD 的输入，例如理想化的渲染或精确的几何图形，无法量化模型在更能反映下游 CAD 重建任务的场景中的表现。最后，尽管 CAD 程序质量取决于几何保真度、程序可执行性和程序紧凑性等多个方面，但现有的评估通常仅限于一种或几种准确性概念。因此，现有评估对三个核心问题的诊断洞察力有限：性能如何随着几何复杂性的增加而变化、模型对于模态转换的鲁棒性如何，以及模型排名和故障模式在特定于 CAD 的评估指标中如何变化。. Methods are often assessed on different input modalities and metrics, making direct comparison between approaches difficult. Current benchmarks also rarely control for complexity and diversity, often overestimating the performance of CAD systems on relatively simple or uniform examples. They frequently rely on clean, CAD-derived inputs, such as idealized renders or exact geometry, failing to quantify how well models perform in scenarios more reflective of downstream CAD reconstruction tasks. Finally, existing evaluations are often limited to one or a few notions of accuracy, even though CAD program quality depends on multiple aspects of geometric fidelity, program executability, and program compactness. As a result, existing evaluations provide limited diagnostic insight into three central questions: how performance changes with increasing geometric complexity, how robust models are to modality shifts, and how model rankings and failure modes vary across CAD-specific evaluation metrics.

我们介绍We introduceCAD基准CadBench（图(Figure1），CAD 程序生成的统一基准，包含六个基准系列中的 18,000 个样本、五种 2D 和 3D 输入模式以及六种主要评估指标。), a unified benchmark for CAD program generation comprising 18,000 samples across six benchmark families, five 2D and 3D input modalities, and six primary evaluation metrics.CAD基准CadBench通过三个核心组件解决当前 CAD 评估中的差距：复杂性和多样性采样分割，用于跨几何难度和基准系列的受控分析；用于测量下游重建设置的鲁棒性的干净和嘈杂的输入模式；以及一个联合捕获体积保真度、表面对齐、局部几何误差、可执行性和程序紧凑性的度量套件。使用addresses the gaps in current CAD evaluation through three core components: complexity- and diversity-sampled splits for controlled analysis across geometric difficulty and benchmark families; clean and noisy input modalities for measuring robustness to downstream reconstruction settings; and a metric suite that jointly captures volumetric fidelity, surface alignment, local geometric error, executability, and program compactness. UsingCAD基准CadBench中，我们评估了超过 140 万代的 11 个 CAD 专用和通用模型，揭示了当前系统如何随着几何复杂性的增加而退化、响应模态变化以及不同评估指标的变化。这些设计选择共同实现了 CAD 生成系统的诊断评估。我们的贡献是：, we evaluate eleven CAD-specialized and general-purpose models across more than 1.4 million generations, revealing how current systems degrade with increased geometric complexity, respond to modality shifts, and vary across evaluation metrics. Together, these design choices enable a diagnostic evaluation of CAD generation systems. Our contributions are:

  • •

    我们介绍We introduceCAD基准CadBench，CAD 程序生成的多模式基准，包括, a multimodal benchmark for CAD program generation comprising18,000 个样本18,000 samples涵盖六个基准系列、五种输入模式和六种评估指标。across six benchmark families, five input modalities, and six evaluation metrics.

  • •

    我们构建了复杂性和多样性感知的评估分割，从而能够跨几何复杂性和基准系列对模型性能进行受控分析。We construct complexity- and diversity-aware evaluation splits that enable controlled analysis of model performance across geometric complexity and benchmark families.

  • •

    我们整合了干净和噪声的 2D 和 3D 输入模态，包括渲染图像、真实感图像、多视图图像、干净网格和噪声网格，从而能够评估模型对模态转换的鲁棒性。We incorporate clean and noisy 2D and 3D input modalities, including rendered images, photorealistic images, multi-view images, clean meshes, and noisy meshes, enabling evaluation of model robustness to modality shift.

  • •

    我们定义了一个多维度量套件，涵盖体积 IoU、表面 IoU、倒角距离、有效形状率、令牌计数和操作计数，捕获 CAD 生成性能的互补方面。We define a multi-dimensional metric suite spanning volumetric IoU, surface IoU, Chamfer distance, valid shape rate, token count, and operation count, capturing complementary aspects of CAD generation performance.

  • •

    我们对 11 个 CAD 专用和通用模型进行了大规模实证研究，涉及多个领域We conduct a large-scale empirical study of eleven CAD-specialized and general-purpose models across more than140万代1.4 million generations，识别关键故障模式，包括几何复杂性退化、模态转换敏感性以及模型性能中与度量相关的差异。, identifying key failure modes including degradation with geometric complexity, sensitivity to modality shift, and metric-dependent differences in model performances.

2 相关工作Related Work

之前的工作已经探索了相关领域，例如文本到 CAD 生成，包括 BlenderLLMPrior work has explored related domains such as text-to-CAD generation, including BlenderLLM[3], Text2CAD [4]、 和 CAD 提示, and CADPrompt[22]。虽然这些方法根据自然语言描述生成 CAD 模型，但工程设计本质上是几何和视觉的，并且许多下游工作流程从 2D 或 3D 观察开始。此外，文本到 CAD 的重建通常不明确，而图像到 CAD 和网格到 CAD 的重建可以根据客观几何基本事实进行评估。因此，在这项工作中，我们重点关注模型从图像或网格输入重建可执行 CAD 程序的测试设置。. While these methods generate CAD models from natural language descriptions, engineering design is inherently geometric and visual, and many downstream workflows begin from 2D or 3D observations. Moreover, text-to-CAD is often underspecified, whereas image-to-CAD and mesh-to-CAD reconstruction can be evaluated against objective geometric ground truth. In this work, we therefore focus on tested settings in which models reconstruct executable CAD programs from image or mesh inputs.

现有 CAD 基准的复杂性和多样性Complexity and Diversity of Existing CAD Benchmarks

由于缺乏模态到 CAD 程序生成的标准化基准，之前的工作通常是根据现有 CAD 数据集（包括 DeepCAD）的数据集特定测试分割来评估模型In the absence of standardized benchmarks for modality-to-CAD program generation, prior work has typically evaluated models on dataset-specific test splits from existing CAD datasets, including DeepCAD[19], Fusion 360 画廊, Fusion 360 Gallery[20], 微型断路器, MCB[21]、CC3D, and CC3D[23]。这些数据集取得了实质性进展，特别是当成对的 CAD 构造序列可用于培训时。桌子. These datasets have enabled substantial progress, particularly when paired CAD construction sequences are available for training. Table1总结了常用的 CAD 基准并报告了几何复杂性和视觉多样性的数据集级度量。summarizes commonly used CAD benchmarks and reports dataset-level measures of geometric complexity and visual diversity.

深CADDeepCAD[19], Fusion 360 画廊, Fusion 360 Gallery[20]和 Omni-CAD, and Omni-CAD[13]数据集提供人工生成的 CAD 样本，但 CAD 操作仅限于草图和拉伸，从而限制了样本的复杂性和评估中表示的操作类型。微型断路器datasets provide human-generated CAD samples, but CAD operations are restricted to sketch-and-extrude only, limiting both the complexity of samples and types of operations represented in evaluation. MCB[21]包含真实的机械组件，但对该数据集的评估仍然局限于一组固定的 68 个对象类别。其他操作更丰富、几何形状更多样化的 CAD 数据集，例如 CC3Dcontains realistic mechanical components, but evaluation on this dataset remains constrained to a fixed set of 68 object categories. Other more operation-rich and geometrically diverse CAD datasets, such as CC3D[23]和ABCand ABC[24]，在基准测试中经常被忽视，也许是因为无法直接获得真实的设计历史。 CADBench 的主要基准应该可以从已发布的工件中独立重现，无需第三方机构数据使用谈判，这就是我们排除 CC3D 的原因。详细信息参见附录 D。, have often been overlooked for benchmarking, perhaps since ground truth design histories are not directly available. CADBench’s primary benchmark should be independently reproducible from released artifacts without third-party institutional data-use negotiations, which is why we exclude CC3D. Details are provided in Appendix D.

这揭示了一个明显的差距：现有基准通常与单个数据集源相关，限制了对特定 CAD 操作类型、复杂性范围或对象类别的评估。这与下游需求不一致，因为 CAD 生成模型必须在各种复杂的生成问题上运行。此外，现有的基准测试并没有明确地针对复杂性和多样性进行划分，限制了它们识别模型故障模式的诊断价值。This reveals a clear gap: existing benchmarks are typically tied to a single dataset source, constraining evaluation to particular CAD operation types, complexity ranges, or object categories. This is misaligned with downstream needs, where CAD generation models must operate across diverse and complex generation problems. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not curate splits explicitly for complexity and diversity, limiting their diagnostic value for identifying model failure modes.

现有 CAD 基准中的模式Modalities in Existing CAD Benchmarks

为了测量图像到 CAD 的重建，一些工作使用图像模态增强了 DeepCAD、Fusion 360 和 MCB 数据集。例如，To measure image-to-CAD reconstruction, several works have augmented the DeepCAD, Fusion 360, and MCB datasets with image modalities. For example,[12, 25]使用 CAD 实体的单视图灰度渲染，同时use single-view grayscale renders of CAD solids, while[10, 6]生成针对特定模型训练范例定制的多视图渲染。对现实图像的评估不太常见。例如，generate multi-view renders tailored for specific model training paradigms. Evaluation on realistic imagery is less common. For instance,[7]使用一小组五张真实照片评估普遍性，同时evaluates generalizability using a small set of five real photographs, while[9]对具有纹理和背景的合成 RGB 渲染进行训练和评估，并另外对物理对象的真实照片进行测试，以评估对现实世界图像的概括。trains and evaluates on synthetic RGB renderings with textures and backgrounds, and additionally tests on real photographs of physical objects to assess generalization to real-world imagery.

对于 3D 到 CAD 重建，许多研究包括For 3D-to-CAD reconstruction, a number of studies, including[11, 14, 15, 26, 27]，使用源自 DeepCAD 和 Fusion 360 等数据集的真实 CAD 实体的点云。然而，对真实数据或噪声数据的评估仍然不常见。, use point clouds derived from ground-truth CAD solids from datasets such as DeepCAD and Fusion 360. However, evaluation on real or noisy data remains uncommon.[23]提供超过 50,000 个虚拟扫描模型的数据集，以模拟真实的传感器噪声，以及provides a dataset of over 50,000 models virtually scanned to simulate realistic sensor noise, and[8]使用 3D 打印零件的真实扫描来研究现实世界输入的性能。此外，Omni-CADuses real scans of 3D-printed parts to investigate performance on real-world inputs. Furthermore, Omni-CAD[13]引入了超过 400,000 个样本的大规模多模态数据集，集成了文本、多视图图像和点云，同时还评估了模型对退化输入（例如噪声或裁剪点云）的适应性。introduces a large-scale multimodal dataset of over 400,000 samples, integrating text, multi-view images, and point clouds, while also evaluating model adaptability to degraded inputs such as noisy or cropped point clouds.

总体而言，当前的 2D 和 3D 到 CAD 评估在很大程度上依赖于理想化输入，通常是 CAD 衍生的渲染、点云或网格。对下游现实世界部署的模式特征（例如照片或 3D 扫描）的综合评估仍然有限。Overall, current 2D- and 3D-to-CAD evaluations rely heavily on idealized inputs, typically CAD-derived renders, point clouds, or meshes. Comprehensive evaluation on modalities characteristic of downstream real-world deployment, such as photographs or 3D scans, remains limited.

CAD 基准测试指标Metrics for CAD Benchmarking

在大多数 CAD 生成模型的现有工作以及用于测试它们的基准中，性能指标主要关注几何相似性，即倒角距离 (CD) 和并交交集 (IoU)In most existing works on generative models for CAD, as well as the benchmarks used to test them, performance metrics focus mostly on geometric similarity– namely, Chamfer Distance (CD) and Intersection over Union (IoU)[12, 19, 10, 6, 11, 7]。此外，这些几何比较指标可能无法完全涵盖目标几何形状的重建程度，因为此类宏观尺度指标根本缺乏捕获精细细节（例如边缘上的圆角）的保真度。最值得注意的是，用于衡量这些指标的方法在不同出版物中并不一致。研究使用几何体上不同数量的采样点来测量 CD，或在测量前采用不同的对齐策略。例如，一些对齐边界框角. Moreover, these geometric comparison metrics may not fully encompass how well a target geometry is being reconstructed, as such macro-scale metrics simply lack the fidelity to capture fine details (e.g., fillets on edges). Most notably, the approach used to measure these metrics is inconsistent across publications. Studies use varying numbers of points sampled on the geometry to measure CD, or employ different alignment strategies before measurement. For example, some align bounding box corners[8]，一些对齐边界框的质心, some align the centroids of bounding boxes[10, 6, 11]，最近，其他人使用连续的 Procrustes 分析来调整, and more recently, others use continuous Procrustes analysis to align[7]。这些限制共同推动了统一的评估协议，具有互补的 CAD 特定指标和一致的测量程序. Together, these limitations motivate a unified evaluation protocol with complementary CAD-specific metrics and consistent measurement procedures

3 方法Methods

3.1 基准建设Benchmark Construction

基准构建通过选择源数据集、分层和采样形状以控制复杂性和多样性以及生成标准化输入模式来进行。Benchmark construction proceeds by selecting source datasets, stratifying and sampling shapes to control complexity and diversity, and generating standardized input modalities.

基准家庭Benchmark Families

CAD基准CadBench旨在评估跨 CAD 重建设置和更具挑战性的分布外几何体的 CAD 程序生成。因此，我们从现有 CAD 和 3D 对象数据集中策划了六个基准系列，涵盖草图和拉伸 CAD 程序、更丰富的 CAD 操作历史记录、机械组件和日常类对象几何图形（图is constructed to evaluate CAD program generation across both CAD reconstruction settings and more challenging out-of-distribution geometry. We therefore curate six benchmark families from existing CAD and 3D object datasets, spanning sketch-and-extrude CAD programs, richer CAD operation histories, mechanical components, and everyday object-like geometry (Figure2）。每个子类别的预处理步骤详见附录). Pre-processing steps for each subcategory are detailed in AppendixA.3。这些步骤建立了初始语料库，然后应用用于复杂性分层和多样性感知采样的多级管道来最终确定基准分割。. These steps establish the initial corpus, after which a multi-stage pipeline for complexity stratification and diversity-aware sampling is applied to finalize the benchmark splits.

复杂性分层和多样性感知采样Complexity Stratification and Diversity-Aware Sampling

我们使用 B-rep 面数作为几何复杂性的代理，将基于 STEP 的基准系列（B、F、E、A）划分为低（L）、中（M）和高（H）复杂度。面数提供了跨基于 STEP 的数据集的一致测量，并反映了定义零件所需的表面数量；先前的工作将其确定为与专家感知的 CAD 建模复杂性最密切相关的基于几何的度量之一We partition the STEP-based benchmark families (B, F, E, A) into Low (L), Medium (M), and High (H) complexity splits using B-rep face count as a proxy for geometric complexity. Face count provides a consistent measure across STEP-based datasets and reflects the number of surfaces needed to define a part; prior work identifies it as one of the geometry-based measures most strongly correlated with expert-perceived CAD modeling complexity[28]。虽然初始分割是通过将人脸计数的对数范围划分为三个相等的间隔来建立的，但我们迭代调整阈值以考虑右偏分布，确保每个 bin 至少包含 1,000 个样本。对于仅具有地面真实网格（M，O）的数据集，这种分层被省略，其中面数主要反映细分密度而不是潜在的几何复杂性。. While initial splits are established by partitioning the logarithmic range of face counts into three equal intervals, we iteratively adjust the thresholds to account for right-skewed distributions, ensuring each bin contains at least 1,000 samples. This stratification is omitted for datasets with only ground-truth meshes (M, O), where face count primarily reflects tessellation density rather than underlying geometric complexity.

为了促进几何多样性，我们采用了采样管道，使用通过附录中的过程提取的嵌入To promote geometric diversity, we employ a sampling pipeline using embeddings extracted via the procedure in AppendixA.2。对于具有复杂性分层的子类别（B、F、E、A），我们执行. For subcategories with complexity stratification (B, F, E, A), we performkk- 表示聚类（-means clustering (k=1,000k=1,000）在每个复杂性层中，每组总共 3,000 个样本。对于其余组（M，O），我们应用) within each complexity tier, totaling 3,000 samples per group. For the remaining groups (M, O), we applykk- 意味着（-means (k=3,000k=3,000）到整个池。计算出簇质心后，我们选择每个质心最近邻的样本作为代表样本。最终，这种双重方法确保基准既按几何复杂性进行分层，又在嵌入空间中更均匀地分布。附录中提供了所有子类别的复杂性阈值和多样性量化) to the entire pool. After computing the cluster centroids, we select the nearest-neighbor sample to each centroid to serve as the representative sample. Ultimately, this dual approach ensures that the benchmark is both stratified by geometric complexity and more evenly distributed across the embedding space. Complexity thresholds and diversity quantification for all subcategories are provided in AppendixB（表(Table4).

我们沿着三个轴评估模型生成的 CAD 程序：We evaluate model-generated CAD programs along three axes:几何保真度geometric fidelity, 可执行性executability, 和, and程序紧凑性program compactness。在预测的实体之间计算几何度量. Geometric metrics are computed between the predicted solidS^\hat{S}和真实形状and the ground-truth shapeSS.

Together, these metrics distinguish volumetric overlap, local geometric deviation, and thresholded surface alignment. We report these metrics after applying the alignment procedure described in AppendixA.5;我们的代码库中也提供了未对齐的指标。对于基准分割，我们报告执行失败的中值 IoU 和中值 SIoU 计为零，以及成功执行的程序的中值 CD。; unaligned metrics are also available in our codebase. For benchmark splits, we report median IoU and median SIoU with failed executions counted as zero, and median CD over successfully executed programs.

我们测量生成的 CAD 程序是否可以执行以生成有效的实体。我们报道We measure whether a generated CAD program can be executed to produce a valid solid. 为了表征模型使用简洁语法重建几何的程度，我们报告了两个度量：To characterize the degree to which a model reconstructs geometry using concise syntax, we report two measures:令牌数Token Count，生成的代币数量，以及, the number of generated tokens, and操作次数Operation Count，生成的程序中 CAD 操作的数量。, the number of CAD operations in the generated program.

聚合基准分数计算为分层指标的加权平均值，权重与每个分层中的样本数量成正比。附录中提供了所有指标的完整数学定义和实现细节Aggregate benchmark scores are computed as weighted averages of split-level metrics, with weights proportional to the number of samples in each split. Full mathematical definitions and implementation details for all metrics are provided in AppendixA.5.

3.3 评估模型Models Evaluated

我们专注于从图像或网格输入生成可执行 CAD 程序的模型，因为可编辑的 CAD 输出对于下游工程工作流程是不可或缺的。因此，我们根据输入模态对评估和分析进行分类：i) 网格条件模型和 ii) 图像条件模型。We focus on models that generate executable CAD programs from image or mesh inputs, as editable CAD outputs are indispensable for downstream engineering workflows. Consequently, we categorize our evaluation and analysis based on the input modality: i) mesh-conditioned and ii) image-conditioned models.

网格条件模型Mesh-conditioned Models

我们将网格条件方法定义为能够接收网格作为输入的模型，通常在内部将其转换为另一种表示形式，例如点云或渲染视图，以便生成可编辑的 CAD 程序或特征树。对于网格条件 CAD 程序生成，我们评估 CAFitWe define mesh-conditioned methods as models capable of receiving a mesh as input, often internally converting it into another representation, such as a point cloud or rendered views, in order to generate an editable CAD program or feature tree. For mesh-conditioned CAD program generation, we evaluate CADFit[29],CADEvolve, CADEvolve[6], CAD 重新编码, CAD-Recode[11]和卡德里尔, and Cadrille[10]。我们评估这些方法是因为它们属于最先进的方法，展示了顶级的重建性能（平均/中值 IoU. We evaluate these methods because they are among the state of the art, demonstrating top-tier reconstruction performance (mean/median IoU≥\geq0.8) 在 DeepCAD 和 Fusion 360 Reconstruction 测试集等既定基准上0.8) on established benchmarks such as DeepCAD and Fusion 360 Reconstruction test sets[29, 6, 11, 10]。使用该方法的默认推理设置在干净和噪声网格模式上评估每个网格条件模型。除了具有确定性的 CADFit 之外，每种网格条件方法都通过三次独立运行进行评估，并且我们报告运行期间的平均值和标准差。. Each mesh-conditioned model is evaluated on both clean and noisy mesh modalities using the method’s default inference settings. With the exception of CADFit, which is deterministic, each mesh-conditioned method is evaluated over three independent runs, and we report the mean and standard deviation across runs.

尽管 Cadrile 和 CADEvolve 也可以从图像输入运行，并且我们对这两种方法进行了评估Although Cadrille and CADEvolve can also be run from image inputs—and we evaluate both methods onCAD基准CadBench的单视图渲染 - 我们主要将它们报告为网格条件方法，因为当根据网格派生的输入进行评估时，它们实现了最强的 CADBench 性能。当图像输入未针对每个模型的本机渲染格式进行定制时，性能会大幅下降；这一发现将在章节中进一步讨论’s single-view renders—we primarily report them as mesh-conditioned methods because they achieve their strongest CADBench performance when evaluated from mesh-derived inputs. Performance degrades substantially when image inputs are not tailored to each model’s native rendering format; this finding is further discussed in Section4.

图像调节模型Image-conditioned models

图像调节模型将一幅或多幅图像作为输入并生成可编辑的 CAD 特征树。我们进一步将它们分为 (1) 通用视觉语言模型 (VLM) 和 (2) CAD 特定图像到 CAD 模型。Image-conditioned models take one or more images as input and generate editable CAD feature trees. We further divide these into (1) general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) and (2) CAD-specific image-to-CAD models.

通用 VLM。General-Purpose VLMs.

我们评估了一组前沿专有 VLM，包括 Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 GPT-5.4。基于在通用多模态推理基准（例如 MMMU-Pro）上的强劲性能，这些模型分别被选为 Anthropic、Google 和 OpenAI 的代表性最先进 VLMWe evaluate a set of frontier proprietary VLMs, including Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.4. These models are selected as representative state-of-the-art VLMs from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI, respectively, based on strong performance on general multimodal reasoning benchmarks (e.g., MMMU-Pro111https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/mmmu-pro）。由于在相同基准测试中表现强劲，我们将开放重量模型 Kimi K2.6 纳入其中。我们还包括开放权重模型 Qwen 3.5 27B 和 Qwen 3.5 9B，因为 Qwen 系列已广泛适应多模式和代码生成任务。对于所有现成的 VLM，我们使用推荐的推理设置；附录中提供了完整的详细信息). We include Kimi K2.6, an open-weight model, due to strong performance on the same benchmark. We also include open-weight models Qwen 3.5 27B and Qwen 3.5 9B, as the Qwen family has been widely adapted for multimodal and code generation tasks. For all off-the-shelf VLMs, we use recommended inference settings; full details are provided in AppendixA.6。对于三种图像模式中的每一种，每个模型都通过三次独立运行进行评估，并报告平均值和标准差。. For each of the three image modalities, each model is evaluated over three independent runs, and we report mean and standard deviation.

CAD 特定模型。CAD-specific models.

对于 CAD 专用的图像调节生成，我们报告 CAD-CoderFor CAD-specialized, image-conditioned generation, we report CAD-Coder[7]作为主要的图像调节 CAD 特定模型。我们还评估了 Cadrile 和 CADEvolve 在图像输入上的完整性，但主要将它们分类为如上所述的网格条件方法。尽管每个模型最初都是针对特定图像格式进行训练的，但我们在测试时不会针对这些特定于模型的格式定制输入。相反，我们使用第 1 节中描述的统一渲染集来评估所有模型as the primary image-conditioned CAD-specific model. We also evaluate Cadrille and CADEvolve on image inputs for completeness, but primarily categorize them as mesh-conditioned methods as explained above. Although each model was originally trained on a specific image format, we do not tailor inputs to these model-specific formats at test time. Instead, we evaluate all models using the unified set of renderings described in Section3.1：单视图、多视图和真实感渲染。 CAD-Coder 具有确定性，每种模式运行一次。: single-view, multi-view, and photorealistic renders. CAD-Coder is deterministic and run once per modality.

4 结果与分析Results and Analysis

CAD基准CadBench既可作为综合排行榜，又可作为分析 CAD 生成性能的诊断基准。我们首先总结干净输入条件下的整体模型性能。然后我们使用serves both as an aggregate leaderboard and as a diagnostic benchmark for analyzing CAD generation performance. We first summarize overall model performance under clean input conditions. We then useCAD基准CadBench的综合分割、模式和指标，以检查性能如何随几何复杂性变化、模型如何响应输入模式转变，以及不同的评估指标是否揭示不同的故障模式。’s comprehensive splits, modalities, and metrics to examine how performance changes with geometric complexity, how models respond to input modality shift, and whether different evaluation metrics reveal distinct failure modes.

当前 CAD 生成器在干净的输入下表现如何？How do current CAD generators perform under clean inputs?

表Table2总结了模型的总体性能summarizes overall model performance onCAD基准CadBench在干净的输入条件下：网格到 CAD 模型的干净网格和图像到 CAD 模型的单视图灰度渲染。附录中提供了详细的每次分割结果under clean input conditions: clean meshes for mesh-to-CAD models and single-view grayscale renders for image-to-CAD models. Detailed per-split results are provided in AppendixC.1.1。在总体水平上，网格条件方法在所有几何保真度指标上都明显优于图像条件方法，反映了直接 3D 观察相对于模糊单视图图像的优势。在所有测试的模型中，CADFit 实现了最强的重建性能，具有最高的 IoU 和 SIoU、最低的 CD 以及完美的有效形状率，尽管该方法的准确性伴随着相当长的推理时间（附录. At the aggregate level, mesh-conditioned methods substantially outperform image-conditioned methods across all geometric fidelity metrics, reflecting the advantage of direct 3D observations over ambiguous single-view images. Among all models tested, CADFit achieves the strongest reconstruction performance, with the highest IoU and SIoU, the lowest CD, and a perfect valid shape rate, though the method’s accuracy comes with substantially longer inference time (AppendixC.1.2).

在图像调节模型中，性能较低，排名取决于指标：Claude Opus 4.7 实现了最高的聚合 IoU，Gemini 3.1 Pro 实现了最低的 Chamfer 距离，CAD-Coder 实现了最高的 SIoU。 CAD-Coder 还在图像调节方法中实现了最高的有效形状率，这表明即使几何保真度仍然有限，特定于 CAD 的训练也可以提高可执行性。相比之下，Qwen 模型实现接近于零的 IoU 主要是因为它们经常无法生成有效的可执行形状，这表明一般代码流畅性并不一定能转化为可靠的 CAD 语法。值得注意的是，开放权重 Kimi K2.6 模型在两个几何保真度指标上优于闭源 GPT 5.4 模型，这表明前沿专有 VLM 并不完全主导 CAD 程序生成。Among image-conditioned models, performance is lower and rankings depend on the metric: Claude Opus 4.7 achieves the highest aggregate IoU, Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves the lowest Chamfer distance, and CAD-Coder achieves the highest SIoU. CAD-Coder also achieves the highest valid shape rate among image-conditioned methods, suggesting that CAD-specific training improves executability even if geometric fidelity remains limited. In contrast, the Qwen models achieve near-zero IoU largely because they often fail to produce valid executable shapes, indicating that general code fluency does not necessarily translate into reliable CAD syntax. Notably, the open-weight Kimi K2.6 model outperforms the closed-source GPT 5.4 model across two geometric fidelity metrics, indicating that frontier proprietary VLMs do not uniformly dominate CAD program generation.

随着几何形状变得更加复杂，CAD 重建是否会变得更加困难？Does CAD reconstruction get harder as geometry becomes more complex?

为了分离几何复杂性和重建保真度之间的关系，我们分析了仅包含草图和拉伸操作的基准系列的性能（B，E）。如图To isolate the relationship between geometric complexity and reconstruction fidelity, we analyze performance on benchmark families containing only sketch-and-extrude operations (B, E). As shown in Figure3，对于网格条件和图像条件方法，分割的 IoU 分数通常会随着分割中值面数的增加而降低。这表明面部计数分层捕获了重建难度的有意义的轴：在低面部计数部分上表现良好的模型通常在较高面部计数的分割上急剧退化。, IoU score on the split generally decreases as split median face count increases for both mesh-conditioned and image-conditioned methods. This indicates that face-count stratification captures a meaningful axis of reconstruction difficulty: models that perform well on low-face-count parts often degrade sharply on higher-face-count splits.

对于 Extrude 系列，许多模型在中复杂度和高复杂度分割上实现了类似的 IoU。这表明可能存在饱和效应，其中模型已经很难恢复中等复杂的草图和拉伸几何形状，因此面数的额外增加不会导致 IoU 成比例降低。 CADFit 是主要的例外，它在复杂性级别上保持相对稳健。附录中提供了包括所有操作拆分在内的补充分析For the Extrude family, many models achieve similar IoU on the medium- and high-complexity splits. This suggests a possible saturation effect, where models already struggle to recover moderately complex sketch-and-extrude geometry, so additional increases in face count do not lead to proportionally lower IoU. CADFit is the main exception, remaining comparatively robust across complexity levels. A complementary analysis including All-Ops splits is provided in AppendixC.2.1;在这个更广泛的环境中，人脸计数和 IoU 之间的关系不太单调，这表明人脸计数在受控操作族中很有用，但在操作词汇量扩大时并不能完全捕获重建困难。; in this broader setting, the relationship between face count and IoU is less monotonic, suggesting that face count is useful within controlled operation families but does not fully capture reconstruction difficulty when operation vocabulary is expanded.

CADEvolve 的小幅消融进一步表明，多样性感知采样增加了基准测试难度：在相同的人脸计数范围内，多样性采样分割产生的中值对齐 IoU 性能低于随机采样分割，其中 Extrude-Medium 的相对下降最大（A small ablation with CADEvolve further suggests that diversity-aware sampling increases benchmark difficulty: within the same face-count range, diversity-sampled splits produce lower median aligned IoU performances than randomly sampled splits, with the largest relative drop on Extrude-Medium (−12.3%-12.3\%;附录; AppendixC.2.2).

CAD 生成器对于模态转换有多脆弱？How fragile are CAD generators to modality shift?

图Figure4比较干净输入模式和转移输入模式的模型性能。网格条件 CAD 专用模型对网格噪声高度敏感：当从干净的网格输入移动到噪声网格输入时，所有评估的方法都会损失至少 0.126 的聚合 IoU（附录compares model performance across clean and shifted input modalities. Mesh-conditioned CAD-specialized models are highly sensitive to mesh noise: all evaluated methods lose at least 0.126 aggregate IoU when moving from clean to noisy mesh inputs (AppendixC.3）。 CADEvolve 的降级最大，从干净网格上的 0.611 IoU 下降到噪声网格上的 0.088 IoU（). The largest degradation occurs for CADEvolve, which drops from 0.611 IoU on clean meshes to 0.088 IoU on noisy meshes (Δ\DeltaIoU = -0.523）。这可以部分地通过复合模态转换效应来解释：CADEvolve 在生成 CAD 代码之前首先将输入网格渲染为多视图图像，因此网格扰动可以通过渲染阶段传播并改变传递给模型的视觉观察结果，从而可能放大几何噪声的影响。IoU = -0.523). This may be partly explained by a compound modality-shift effect: CADEvolve first renders the input mesh into multi-view images before generating CAD code, so mesh perturbations can propagate through the rendering stage and alter the visual observations passed to the model, potentially amplifying the effect of geometric noise.

图像条件 CAD 专用模型也会因输入变化而降级。 CAD-Coder 在真实感渲染上略有下降（Image-conditioned CAD-specialized models also degrade under input shifts. CAD-Coder drops modestly on photorealistic renders (Δ\DeltaIoU = -0.073），但更重要的是多视图输入（IoU = -0.073), but more substantially on multi-view inputs (Δ\DeltaIoU = -0.184）相对于单视图灰度渲染。由于 CAD-Coder 是在单视图图像上进行训练的，这表明视图合成比单独的渲染风格更具破坏性。当从图像输入进行评估时，我们观察到 Cadrile 和 CADEvolve 具有相似的敏感性：尽管两种方法都可以接受图像，但在IoU = -0.184) relative to single-view grayscale renders. Because CAD-Coder was trained on single-view images, this suggests that view composition is more disruptive than rendering style alone. We observe a similar sensitivity for Cadrille and CADEvolve when they are evaluated from image inputs: although both methods can accept images, performance is poor onCAD基准CadBench的标准化单视图渲染，可能是因为这些输入与训练期间使用的图像格式不同。相比之下，通用 VLM 在不同图像模式下的聚合 IoU 变化相对较小，这表明对光照、材质和视图布局变化的鲁棒性更强（附录’s standardized single-view renders, likely because these inputs differ from the image formats used during training. In contrast, general-purpose VLMs show comparatively small changes in aggregate IoU across image modalities, indicating stronger robustness to changes in lighting, material, and view layout (AppendixC.3).

这些结果揭示了当前模型的权衡：CAD 专用模型在干净或熟悉的输入下实现了最强的性能，但在实际模态转换下可能会急剧下降，而通用 VLM 对输入变化更稳健，但总体精度仍然较低。这表明 CAD 生成方法需要将几何精度与下游输入条件的稳健性（实际应用的特征）结合起来。These results reveal a trade-off in current models: CAD-specialized models achieve the strongest performance under clean or familiar inputs, but can degrade sharply under realistic modality shifts, while general-purpose VLMs are more robust to input variation but remain substantially less accurate overall. This points to the need for CAD generation methods that combine geometric accuracy with robustness to downstream input conditions, characteristic of real-world applications.

是否需要多个几何保真度指标？Are multiple geometric fidelity metrics necessary?

表中综合排名Aggregate rankings in Table2取决于几何保真度度量的选择。在图像调节模型中，Claude Opus 4.7 实现了最高的 IoU，Gemini 3.1 Pro 实现了最低的 CD，CAD-Coder 实现了最高的 SIoU。尽管这些差异不大，并且所有图像条件模型仍然远低于最强的网格条件方法，但排名的变化表明 IoU、CD 和 SIoU 捕获了重建质量的不同方面，而不是提供可互换的测量。depend on the choice of geometric fidelity metric. Among image-conditioned models, Claude Opus 4.7 achieves the highest IoU, Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves the lowest CD, and CAD-Coder achieves the highest SIoU. Although these differences are modest and all image-conditioned models remain far below the strongest mesh-conditioned methods, the change in ranking suggests that IoU, CD, and SIoU capture distinct aspects of reconstruction quality rather than providing interchangeable measurements.

为了量化这种关系，我们计算了所有语法上有效的模型生成的 CAD 程序中 IoU、SIoU 和 CD 之间的样本级斯皮尔曼等级相关性（附录To quantify this relationship, we compute sample-level Spearman rank correlations between IoU, SIoU, and CD across all syntactically valid model-generated CAD programs (AppendixC.4.1）。这些指标表现出预期的方向关系，但并不冗余：IoU 和 SIoU 仅中等相关（). The metrics exhibit the expected directional relationships but are not redundant: IoU and SIoU are only moderately correlated (ρ=0.45\rho=0.45），而 CD 与 IoU 负相关（), while CD is negatively correlated with both IoU (ρ=−0.62\rho=-0.62) 和 SIoU () and SIoU (ρ=−0.85\rho=-0.85）。 CD 和 SIoU 之间更强的相关性可能反映出两者都是基于表面的指标，而 IoU 则衡量体积一致性。这些结果促使我们报告所有三个指标。附录). The stronger correlation between CD and SIoU likely reflects that both are surface-based metrics, whereas IoU measures volumetric agreement. These results motivate reporting all three metrics. AppendixC.4.2进一步说明了 IoU 和 SIoU 提供补充诊断信息的情况：高 IoU 可以掩盖恢复精细表面细节的失败，而当表面靠近目标但封闭的体积不正确时，可能会出现高 SIoU。这种区别在 CAD 中非常重要，其中齿、孔、凹槽和界面等表面特征对于零件功能至关重要。further illustrates cases where IoU and SIoU provide complementary diagnostic information: high IoU can mask failures to recover fine surface details, while high SIoU can occur when surfaces are near the target but the enclosed volume is incorrect. Such distinctions are important in CAD, where surface features such as teeth, holes, grooves, and interfaces can be critical to part function.

5 结论Conclusion

我们介绍了We introducedCAD基准CadBench，用于 CAD 程序生成的统一多模式基准，涵盖六个基准系列、复杂性和多样性采样分割、干净和噪声输入模式以及六个主要评估指标。除了充当整体排行榜之外，这些基准设计选择还可以对当前 CAD 生成器的成功和失败进行有针对性的分析。复杂性分层分割使我们能够了解随着几何难度的增加，重建性能如何变化，这表明大多数模型在较高复杂性的形状上会大幅退化。干净和嘈杂的模态变体使我们能够评估输入变化的稳健性，这表明 CAD 专用模型通常在干净的输入下实现强大的性能，但在嘈杂或不太熟悉的模态下可能会急剧下降，而通用 VLM 更稳健，但总体精度仍然较低。最后，包含多个几何保真度指标使我们能够测试模型排名是否依赖于指标，证明 IoU、CD 和 SIoU 捕获重建质量的互补方面，而不是可互换的测量。总体而言，, a unified multimodal benchmark for CAD program generation spanning six benchmark families, complexity- and diversity-sampled splits, clean and noisy input modalities, and six primary evaluation metrics. In addition to serving as an overall leaderboard, these benchmark design choices enable targeted analysis of where current CAD generators succeed and fail. The complexity-stratified splits allow us to ask how reconstruction performance changes as geometric difficulty increases, revealing that most models degrade substantially on higher-complexity shapes. The clean and noisy modality variants allow us to evaluate robustness to input shift, showing that CAD-specialized models often achieve strong performance under clean inputs but can degrade sharply under noisier or less familiar modalities, while general-purpose VLMs are more robust but remain less accurate overall. Finally, the inclusion of multiple geometric fidelity metrics allows us to test whether model rankings are metric-dependent, demonstrating that IoU, CD, and SIoU capture complementary aspects of reconstruction quality rather than interchangeable measurements. Overall,CAD基准CadBench为衡量人工智能辅助 CAD 重建的进展奠定了基础，并强调未来需要将几何精度、可执行和可编辑输出、紧凑的施工程序以及对实际输入条件的鲁棒性结合起来的方法。provides a foundation for measuring progress in AI-assisted CAD reconstruction and highlights the need for future methods that combine geometric accuracy, executable and editable outputs, compact construction procedures, and robustness to realistic input conditions.

局限性。Limitations.

我们在操作上使用“可编辑 CAD 程序”：生成的程序必须在 CAD 内核中执行，以生成可以作为代码进行检查和手动编辑的有效实体。We use “editable CAD program” operationally: a generated program must execute in a CAD kernel to produce a valid solid that can be inspected and manually edited as code.CAD基准CadBench不需要恢复原始设计者的特征树、草图约束、构造顺序、参数化或设计意图。这是不可避免的，因为只有一些源族提供人工编写的构造历史，而仅几何族提供最终形状，但不提供创建它们的建模过程。因此，does not require recovery of the original designer’s feature tree, sketch constraints, construction order, parameterization, or design intent. This is unavoidable because only some source families provide human-authored construction histories, while geometry-only families provide final shapes but not the modeling processes that created them. Thus,CAD基准CadBench评估可执行的实体重建、几何保真度和程序紧凑性，但不能统一测量操作级等效性、语义程序等效性、约束或与人类创作的特征树的对应性；这些仍然是未来基准的重要方向。我们的 VLM 评估还衡量标准化的直接生成，而不是最佳可实现的性能：我们使用固定提示，而不进行大量的提示调整、工具使用、自我修正或多轮代理细化，所有这些都可以提高绝对性能。最后，我们基于 STEP 的复杂性分割使用 B-rep 面计数，这是一致但不完整的：重复的模式（例如孔阵列）可以主导高面数分割，这使得它们具有挑战性，但偏向于一种形式的 CAD 复杂性。evaluates executable solid reconstruction, geometric fidelity, and program compactness, but cannot uniformly measure operation-level equivalence, semantic program equivalence, constraints, or correspondence to a human-authored feature tree; these remain important directions for future benchmarks. Our VLM evaluation also measures standardized direct generation rather than best-achievable performance: we use fixed prompts without extensive prompt tuning, tool use, self-correction, or multi-turn agentic refinement, all of which may improve absolute performance. Finally, our STEP-based complexity splits use B-rep face count, which is consistent but incomplete: repeated patterns such as arrays of holes can dominate high-face-count splits, making them challenging but biased toward one form of CAD complexity.

A.2 使用 DINOv3 提取对象的特征向量Extracting Feature Vectors for Objects using DINOv3

为了获得数据集中每个对象的代表性特征向量，我们采用了基于视觉的编码管道，其灵感来自于中使用的过程To obtain a representative feature vector for each object across our datasets, we employ a vision-based encoding pipeline inspired by the procedure utilized in[32]。每个对象都使用以下方法渲染成八个灰度等距视图. Each object is rendered into eight grayscale isometric views using蟒蛇OCCpythonOCC并通过 DINOv3 进行处理and processed through a DINOv3[33]骨干（backbone (dinov3-vitb16-预训练-lvd1689mdinov3-vitb16-pretrain-lvd1689m）来提取 768 维的潜在嵌入。然后对这些向量进行平均以产生每个对象的单个代表性特征向量。这种基于图像的过程对于各种 3D 文件格式（包括 STEP、STL、GLB 和 OBJ）都非常有效。) to extract 768-dimensional latent embeddings. These vectors are then averaged to produce a single representative feature vector per object. This image-based procedure is highly effective across various 3D file formats, including STEP, STL, GLB, and OBJ.

A.3 有关创建工作台子类别的更多详细信息More Details about creating Bench Subcategories

CAD 基础 (B)：CAD-Base (B):

该子类别由源自 DeepCAD 数据集的 CAD 模型组成。我们使用了 GenCAD 论文中介绍的 DeepCAD 测试分割This subcategory consists of CAD Models derived from the DeepCAD dataset. We used the DeepCAD test split introduced in the GenCAD paper[12]，由 7629 个样本组成。我们首先过滤数据集以消除重复并过滤仅包含单个身体的样本。这种排除多体设计和装配的动机是特征树重建任务的性质，该任务从根本上是针对单个零件的。在标准工程工作流程中，装配体并未设计为单个特征树中的整体实体。相反，每个组件都是独立设计的，具有自己的功能历史。为了符合这一设计意图，我们过滤掉了由多个主体组成的模型，总共留下了 6210 个样本。然后，我们应用基于复杂性的分层和多样性感知采样，如第 1 节中所述, consisting of 7629 samples. We first filtered the dataset to de-duplicate and to filter to only samples containing single bodies. This exclusion of multi-body designs and assemblies is motivated by the nature of the feature tree reconstruction task, which is fundamentally intended for individual parts. In standard engineering workflows, assemblies are not designed as a monolithic entity within a single feature tree. Instead, each component is designed independently with its own feature history. To align with this design intent, we filtered out models consisting of multiple bodies, leaving a total of 6210 samples. We then applied complexity-based stratification and diversity-aware sampling as described in Section3.

CAD 融合 (F)：CAD-Fusion (F):

此子类别由源自 Fusion 360 重建和分割数据集的 CAD 模型组成。由于 Fusion 360 重建测试集仅包含 1,725 个样本，因此我们使用 Fusion 360 分割数据集中的模型对其进行了增强。根据 CAD-Base 过滤标准，我们排除了所有多体设计，总共留下 37,184 个 CAD 模型。然后，我们应用基于复杂性的分层和多样性感知采样，如第 1 节中所述This subcategory consists of CAD Models derived from the Fusion 360 Reconstruction and Segmentation datasets. Since the Fusion 360 Reconstruction test set contains only 1,725 samples, we augmented it with models from the Fusion 360 Segmentation Dataset. Following the CAD-Base filtering criteria, we excluded all multi-body designs, leaving a total of 37,184 CAD models. We then applied complexity-based stratification and diversity-aware sampling as described in Section3.

Utilizing the original FeatureScript (的ofsofs）文件，我们进一步过滤掉包含基于文本的模型（) files, we further filtered out models containing text-based (BTM草图文本实体BTMSketchTextEntity) 或基于图像的 () or image-based (BTMsketchImageEntityBTMSketchImageEntity）草图。然后，剩余模型根据其操作历史记录分为两个不同的分区：一个分区（) sketches. Finally, complexity-based stratification and diversity-aware sampling were applied to create CAD-Extrude and CAD-All-Ops, respectively.

CAD-机械（M）：CAD-Mechanical (M):

该子类别由源自 MCB 数据集的样本组成。我们使用 MCB 数据集的测试分割，其中包含 11716 个样本。然后，我们进行了无懈可击的检查和修复，过滤为单体样本，删除了重复项，并消除了未生成图像的样本；剩下 7106 个样本。然后，我们应用了多样性感知抽样，如第 1 节中所述This subcategory consists of samples derived from the MCB dataset. We use the test split from the MCB Dataset, consisting of 11716 samples. We then ran a watertight check and repair, filtered to single body samples, removed duplicates, and eliminated samples for which no images were generated; this left 7106 samples. We then applied diversity-aware sampling as described in Section3获得 3000 个样本的子集。原始 MCB 数据集分为 68 类机械对象。通过我们的多样性抽样程序，3000 个样本基准中代表了 67/68 个类别。最具代表性的三个类别是 1) 传统铆钉，2) 键和键槽、花键，以及 3) 圆柱头螺钉和螺栓。to obtain a subset of 3000 samples. The original MCB dataset is split into 68 classes of mechanical objects. Through our diversity sampling procedure, 67/68 classes were represented in the 3000 sample benchmark. The three most represented classes are 1) conventional rivets, 2) keys and keyways, splines, and 3) screws and bolts with cylindrical heads.

CAD-有机 (O)：CAD-Organic (O):

该子类别由源自 Objaverse 数据集的样本组成。虽然 Objaverse 是通用 3D 模型的大型集合，但我们根据其几何结构和功能设计选择被认为最“适合 CAD”的特定类别：This subcategory consists of samples derived from the Objaverse dataset. While Objaverse is a large-scale collection of general 3D models, we select specific categories deemed most "CAD-suitable" based on their geometric structure and functional design:

  • •

    家具-家居Furniture-Home

  • •

    科学技术Science-Technology

  • •

    建筑Architecture

  • •

    汽车-车辆Cars-Vehicles

  • •

    电子产品Electronics-Gadgets

从大约 800,000 个模型的初始池中，过滤这些类别产生了 226,865 个样本的最终子集。 为了确保数据集中使用的网格的几何有效性，我们应用了网格修复管道，尽可能将非水密网格转换为水密流形。当网格形成没有孔或边界边的闭合 2 流形表面时，该网格被认为是水密的。无懈可击的网格对于许多下游任务（例如体积计算、物理模拟、几何学习模型和表面重建）至关重要。然而，大型数据集中的许多网格（例如 Objaverse）都包含几何缺陷，包括表面中的孔、重复的顶点或面、非流形边、未引用的顶点和退化三角形。为了解决这些问题，我们使用 PyMeshLab 实现了修复管道，它提供了强大的网格处理过滤器。我们随后对单体样本进行去重和过滤，剩下 20148 个样本。然后，我们应用上述基于网格的数据集过程来选择 3000 个样本的基准子集。From an initial pool of approximately 800,000 models, filtering for these categories yielded a final subset of 226,865 samples. To ensure geometric validity of the meshes used in our dataset, we applied a mesh repair pipeline to convert non-watertight meshes into watertight manifolds whenever possible. A mesh is considered watertight when it forms a closed 2-manifold surface with no holes or boundary edges. Watertight meshes are essential for many downstream tasks such as volume computation, physical simulation, geometry learning models, and surface reconstruction. However, many meshes in large-scale datasets such as Objaverse contain geometric defects, including holes in the surface, duplicate vertices or faces, non-manifold edges, unreferenced vertices, and degenerate triangles. To address these issues, we implemented a repair pipeline using PyMeshLab, which provides robust mesh-processing filters. We subsequently de-duplicated and filtered for single body samples, which left 20148 samples. We then applied the mesh-based dataset procedure described above to select a benchmark subset of 3000 samples.

Ground planes are assigned random textures from a curated library of realistic materials (e.g., asphalt, grass, brick, and concrete). Illumination is provided by a three-point lighting configuration (key, fill, and back lights). The camera pose is configured to render an isometric view under perspective projection with a 60° Field of View (FOV). Additionally, the position of the camera is adjusted based on the diameter of the bounding sphere of each model to ensure that the object is not cropped.

附录BAppendix BCADBench 与其他基准的扩展比较Expanded Comparison of CADBench with Other Benchmarks

我们评估We evaluateCAD基准CadBench相对于 DeepCAD、Fusion 360 Reconstruction、MCB 和 Omni-CAD 等既定基准，跨越三个主轴：复杂性、相似性和几何规范性。我们通过 B-Rep 面部计数来量化复杂性。使用集合中所有对象的特征向量之间的成对余弦相似度来评估基准内对象的相似性（参见附录relative to established benchmarks, such as DeepCAD, Fusion 360 Reconstruction, MCB, and Omni-CAD, across three primary axes: complexity, similarity, and geometric canonicality. We quantify complexity via B-Rep face count. Similarity of objects within a benchmark is assessed using the pairwise cosine similarities between the feature vectors of all objects in the set (see AppendixA.2用于获取特征向量的过程）。为了进一步表征几何规范性，我们使用两个指标来测量基准对象与单位立方体的相似度：（i）体积交并（IoU）和（ii）对象特征向量与单位立方体特征向量之间的余弦相似度。for the procedure to get the feature vectors). To further characterize geometric canonicality, we measure the similarity of benchmark objects to a unit cube using two metrics: (i) the volumetric Intersection over Union (IoU) and (ii) the cosine similarity between the feature vector of the object and that of a unit cube.

C.2 了解复杂性和多样性采样的影响Understanding the Effects of Complexity and Diversity Sampling

在本节中，我们将进一步研究在基准分割中包含复杂性分层和多样性感知采样的影响。In this section, we further investigate the impact of including complexity-stratification and diversity-aware sampling in our benchmark splits.

C.2.1 操作词汇量扩大时，面数衡量难度吗？Does face count measure difficulty when operation vocabulary is expanded?

C.2.2 DINOv3 多样性采样重要吗？ — 多样性选择与随机评估Does DINOv3 diversity sampling matter? — Diversity-selected versus random evaluation

为了评估多样性感知采样对测量模型性能的影响，我们构建了 Base-Low、Base-Medium、Extrude-Low 和 Extrude-Medium 分割的随机采样变体，同时保留用于复杂性分层的相同面计数范围。然后我们在多样性采样上评估 CADEvolveTo assess the effect of diversity-aware sampling on measured model performance, we construct randomly sampled variants of the Base-Low, Base-Medium, Extrude-Low, and Extrude-Medium splits while preserving the same face-count ranges used for complexity stratification. We then evaluate CADEvolve on both the diversity-sampledCAD基准CadBench分割和相应的随机分割（表splits and the corresponding random splits (Table9）。在所有四个分割中，多样性选择的样本产生的中值 IoU 低于随机采样的样本，这表明多样性感知采样可以在相同的标称复杂性范围内暴露更具挑战性的评估案例。对于 Base-Low、Base-Medium 和 Extrude-Low 影响不大，相对下降 1-2%，但对于 Extrude-Medium 影响较大，IoU 下降 12.3%。这种较大的下降可能表明该范围内的随机采样包括更多视觉或几何冗余示例，而基于 DINOv3 的采样选择了一组更加多样化的草图和拉伸几何形状。). Across all four splits, diversity-selected samples yield lower median IoU than randomly sampled examples, suggesting that diversity-aware sampling can expose more challenging evaluation cases within the same nominal complexity range. The effect is modest for Base-Low, Base-Medium, and Extrude-Low, with relative decreases of 1–2%, but is larger for Extrude-Medium, where IoU decreases by 12.3%. This larger drop may indicate that random sampling in this range includes more visually or geometrically redundant examples, while DINOv3-based sampling selects a more varied set of sketch-and-extrude geometries.

C.3 不同输入方式的性能差异Performance Deltas Across Input Modalities

下表报告了跨输入模式的性能增量，提供了模型对网格噪声、真实感渲染、多视图输入和标准化单视图渲染格式的鲁棒性的更详细视图。The following tables report performance deltas across input modalities, providing a more detailed view of model robustness to mesh noise, photorealistic rendering, multi-view inputs, and standardized single-view render formats.

C.4 这些指标是否具有诊断意义？Are the Metrics Diagnostic?

C.4.1 IoU、Chamfer 距离和 SIoU 是否多余？ — 度量相关分析Are IoU, Chamfer distance, and SIoU redundant? — Metric correlation analysis

为了评估我们的几何保真度指标是否提供补充信息，我们在大约 90 万个语法有效的模型生成的 CAD 程序中计算样本级 Spearman 相关性，并可视化相应的成对指标关系。 IoU 和 SIoU 仅中度相关，而 CD 与这两个越高越好的指标呈负相关，表明这些指标是相关的但并不冗余。To assess whether our geometric fidelity metrics provide complementary information, we compute sample-level Spearman correlations across approximately 900k syntactically valid model-generated CAD programs and visualize the corresponding pairwise metric relationships. IoU and SIoU are only moderately correlated, while CD is negatively correlated with both higher-is-better metrics, indicating that these metrics are related but not redundant.

C.4.2 什么时候一种几何保真度指标还不够？ — 高 IoU/低 SIoU 和高 SIoU/低 IoU 示例When is one geometric fidelity metric not enough? — High-IoU/low-SIoU and high-SIoU/low-IoU examples

图Figure11可视化 IoU 和 SIoU 不一致的两种情况。在高 IoU/低 SIoU 情况下，生成的固体恢复了目标的整体体积，但错过了精细的表面结构，导致尽管体积重叠很强，但表面覆盖率很差。在低 IoU/高 SIoU 情况下，生成的模型将表面放置在目标几何体附近，但无法恢复正确的封闭体积，例如由于厚度不正确。这些例子说明了为什么体积指标和基于表面的指标是互补的而不是可以互换的。visualizes two cases where IoU and SIoU disagree. In the high-IoU/low-SIoU case, the generated solid recovers the target’s overall volume but misses fine surface structure, leading to poor surface coverage despite strong volumetric overlap. In the low-IoU/high-SIoU case, the generated model places surfaces near the target geometry but fails to recover the correct enclosed volume, for example due to incorrect thickness. These examples illustrate why volumetric and surface-based metrics are complementary rather than interchangeable.

访问控制的数据集：Access-controlled datasets:CC3D 是一个重要且广泛使用的扫描到 CAD 基准，我们将其包含在相关数据集和先前评估设置的讨论中。但是，我们并未将 CC3D 包含在主要 CADBench 评估套件或发布的聚合基准中，因为对数据集的访问受单独的机构数据使用协议的约束，该协议必须由潜在用户请求并执行。相比之下，CADBench 是围绕可以由审阅者和未来用户直接检查、复制和重新运行的工件而设计的，而无需额外的第三方许可谈判。因此，CADBench 不报告 CC3D 的定量结果。这种排除反映了可重复性和发布设计的考虑，而不是对 CC3D 作为基准的科学价值或重要性的任何判断。CC3D is an important and widely used scan-to-CAD benchmark, and we include it in our discussion of related datasets and prior evaluation settings. However, we do not include CC3D in the primary CADBench evaluation suite or released aggregate benchmark because access to the dataset is governed by a separate institutional data-use agreement that must be requested and executed by prospective users. In contrast, CADBench is designed around artifacts that can be directly inspected, reproduced, and rerun by reviewers and future users without requiring additional third-party licensing negotiations. For this reason, CADBench does not report quantitative results on CC3D. This exclusion reflects a reproducibility and release-design consideration rather than any judgment about the scientific value or importance of CC3D as a benchmark.

更广泛的影响和负责任的使用：Broader impacts and responsible use:

CADBench 旨在通过跨不同模式和基准系列提供几何保真度、可执行性和程序紧凑性的标准化评估，支持开发更可靠的人工智能辅助 CAD 工具。 CAD 生成人工智能工具可以减少创建可编辑工程模型所需的时间和专业知识，并改善对 CAD 工作流程的访问。然而，AI CAD 生成系统也可能被滥用来生成不安全或验证不充分的设计，或者可能导致用户在安全关键型工程环境中过度信任生成的 CAD 程序。 CADBench 是一个评估基准，而不是一个已部署的设计系统，基准性能不应被解释为生成的 CAD 模型适合制造或实际使用的认证。我们建议在制造或部署之前，由合格的工程师审查任何生成的 CAD 模型，并通过适合领域的模拟、分析和安全检查进行验证。CADBench is intended to support progress toward more reliable AI-assisted CAD tools by providing standardized evaluation of geometric fidelity, executability, and program compactness across different modalities and benchmark families. CAD-generating AI tools could reduce the time and expertise required to create editable engineering models and improve access to CAD workflows. However, AI CAD generation systems could also be misused to generate unsafe or poorly validated designs, or could lead users to over-trust generated CAD programs in safety-critical engineering contexts. CADBench is an evaluation benchmark rather than a deployed design system, and benchmark performance should not be interpreted as certification that generated CAD models are suitable for manufacturing or real-world use. We recommend that any generated CAD models be reviewed by qualified engineers and validated with domain-appropriate simulation, analysis, and safety checks before fabrication or deployment.
